sentences.text: This petition is filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. praying to enlarge the petitioner, sole accused, on bail in Crime No.179/2022 of Rajagopalanagar Police Station.

2. Charge sheet is filed against the petitioner and his parents for offence punishable under Sections 498(A), 306 read with 34 of IPC.
3.

It is alleged that complainant's daughter, deceased-Smt.Nagamani, was given in marriage to the petitioner, about 11 years prior to the date of incident and she was being subjected to physical and mental torture for petty reasons and he was quarrelling with her, etc.

It is further alleged that the petitioner was having illicit relationship with some other woman and being unable to tolerate the torture and due to the instigation and abetment by the petitioner and his parents, she committed suicide on 23.05.2022 at about 2.00 pm by hanging herself in her house.
NC: 2023:KHC:19994 4.
The fact that the marriage between the petitioner and deceased took place about 11 years prior to the incident is not disputed.
In their wedlock two children are born to them.
It is also not in dispute that the deceased was staying with her husband and two minor children in a rented house situated at Byraveshwaranagar, Laggere, Bengaluru.

The complaint lodged by the mother of the deceased would reveal that on 24.05.2022 at about 5.30 am her son-in-law i.e., the petitioner herein, called her over phone and informed that on the previous night at about 9.00 pm when he returned to the house and knocked the door, no one opened the door and therefore, he went back to his village.

Therefore, the complainant asked one Anantharaju to go near the house of his daughter, who went and found that complainant's- daughter had committed suicide by hanging herself to the ceiling fan in the bedroom.

5. The allegations are that, on account of physical and mental torture and at the instigation and abetment of NC: 2023:KHC:19994 the petitioner and his parents, complainant's daughter committed suicide.
It is further alleged that the petitioner is having illicit relationship with some other woman.
6. The petitioner was arrested on 25.05.2022.

Whether the petitioner has intentionally aided or abetted the deceased to commit suicide and whether the ingredients of the offence alleged are made out or not, is a matter which has to be established during trial.
Investigation is completed and charge sheet is filed.
Petitioner is in judicial custody for more than one year.

He has undertaken to Sri Ranganatha vs State By on 12 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121955790/
2 furnish sufficient surety to ensure his presence before the trial Court.

sentences.text: Hence, by taking care of the apprehension expressed by the State that the petitioner may tamper with the prosecution witnesses and flee from justice, by imposing suitable conditions, petitioner can be released on bail.

Hence, the following:
ORDER Petition is allowed.

NC: 2023:KHC:19994 Petitioner/accused in Crime No.179/2022 of Rajagopalnagar Police Station, pending in S.C.No.2186/2022 on the file of the XLV Additional City Civil and Sessions Judge, at Bengaluru, shall be released on bail subject to following conditions:
a) Petitioner shall execute a bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only)
with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the learned Sessions Judge.
b) Petitioner shall furnish proof of his residential address and shall inform the Investigation Officer/Court, if there is any change in the address.
c) Petitioner shall not leave the jurisdiction of the trial Court without prior permission of the learned Sessions Judge.
d) Petitioner shall not tamper with the prosecution witnesses either directly or indirectly.
NC: 2023:KHC:19994 e) Petitioner shall appear before the trial Court on all dates of hearing without fail.
